sealed_record.thesis: Every dollar of Robinhood Chain revenue pays Arbitrum a 10% Orbit fee, and the entire market has spent the last week debating what that revenue means for HOOD while ignoring who collects the toll. At the trailing-30d annualized run rate of $408m the Orbit royalty is roughly $41m/yr, at the last-7d rate of $298m it is ~$30m/yr, and at the Sep 14 single-day annualized rate of $147m it is ~$15m/yr - an uncapped call option on a chain that already out-earns Robinhood's entire crypto arm ($400m annualized) within months of launch. Citizens' 2027 base case of $365m implies the royalty keeps compounding even under sell-side conservatism, and Vlad's team has every incentive to accelerate a product that prints this much. The market is pricing the operator and not the landlord.
